notes: Modified cash basis audit, FYE 9/30/2023. Governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds column (pp4-5); business-type from the proprietary (Enterprise Fund) statement p7, measure 'net position' as printed (equal to its cash). Per user ruling, fund balances are recorded as fund balances (beginning 1,309,491 / ending 1,333,710, p5); beginning cash is not printed (null); ending cash = cash and cash equivalents 1,014,108 (p3), certificates of deposit 306,642 as ending_investments, county treasurer cash 12,960 printed separately. Statement 'Intergovernmental' 178,375 split using the General Fund schedule's printed breakdown (p9) of its 40,231; Debt Service 13,621 + Road 124,523 keep the parent label. 'Other receipts' 30,253 not split (its schedule pieces add to 30,254). Transfers: Total column shows transfers in blank and transfers out 19,163 after the Reclassifications column nets 119,913 of interfund transfers; Enterprise transfers in 19,163. Bond proceeds 280,000 (Road) under other financing sources -> debt_proceeds; Enterprise bond anticipation note proceeds 420,000 are printed in nonoperating revenues (p7) so recorded as a business-type receipt. Business-type receipts total = operating 219,412 + nonoperating revenues 421,203 (no single printed total); disbursements = Statement of Activities business-type expenditures 793,398 (p1). Balance sheet: governmental lines from the governmental funds statement of assets and fund balances (p3; totals equal the government-wide figures), business-type from p6; totals from p2. Detail: per-fund budget schedules (General Fund types pp9-12, Debt Service p13, Special Revenue types p14 combining Road and CDA, Water p15, Sewer p16); the all-funds budget schedule (p8) is not recorded to avoid double counting. Special revenue object lines assigned to Road (streets) or CDA (community development) functions from the p4-5 fund columns. Read pages 1-16 of 16
